meta.ogDescription: Stop paying more because of weak management. Free diagnostic, structured operations and the GECOM Portal to track everything in real time.

hero.headline: Stop paying more because your import operation lacks management.
hero.headlineAlt: Are your import and export operations costing more than they should?
hero.subheadline: GECOM audits, structures and operates your foreign trade routine with real visibility into costs, compliance and deadlines.
hero.body: Companies that rely only on customs brokers, trading companies or consulting often live with hidden costs, rework and low predictability. GECOM integrates operational intelligence, execution and technology to remove those losses.
hero.panelTitle: Tax control, real cost visibility and execution inside the same operation.

panelItems.title: Tax audit
panelItems.body: We review NCM, documentation and risk points before an error turns into cost.

panelItems.title: Transparent costs
panelItems.body: Independent cost visibility so you can negotiate better and pay less.

panelItems.title: Tracked execution
panelItems.body: Statuses, documents and critical decisions centralized in the GECOM Portal.

problems.title: Do any of these scenarios look familiar in your operation?
problems.closing: If any of these points already show up in your routine, there is real room to reduce cost and increase control.

cards.title: Your broker executes. But who audits the tax classification?
cards.body: Your customs broker executes, but who checks whether the tax classification is correct? An NCM mistake can generate fines, tax differences and rework without you noticing.

cards.title: A trading company simplifies operations. But is the real cost visible?
cards.body: A trading company simplifies your operation, but it also makes cost formation opaque. Without independent visibility, you may be paying more without knowing it.

cards.title: Planning without execution usually leaks margin.
cards.body: Consulting delivers the plan. Execution stays with your team. In foreign trade, the gap between strategy and operation is where money gets lost.

method.title: How GECOM leads your operation
method.subtitle: We combine diagnostic work, operational design and ongoing execution in a single workflow.

steps.title: We audit
steps.body: We map documents, tax classification, suppliers, visible costs and hidden costs to identify where losses are happening.

steps.title: We structure
steps.body: We design the right operating model for your volume, complexity, regulatory risks and dependence on intermediaries.

steps.title: We operate
steps.body: We support end-to-end execution with indicators, alerts and real-time visibility through the GECOM Portal.

portal.title: Operations stop being a black box when everything is visible in one place.
portal.subtitle: The GECOM Portal centralizes documents, statuses, deadlines, owners and critical milestones so clients can follow import and export routines without parallel spreadsheets or fragmented updates.
portal.summary: Instead of information scattered across email, spreadsheets, brokers, trading companies and internal teams, the client follows the operation in one environment: process timeline, documents, alerts, pending items and a consolidated routine view.
portal.availability: Available exclusively in the Complete Operation engagement model.
features: Process timeline with critical operational milestones
Documents and pending items centralized in one panel
Alerts for deadlines, shipment, customs clearance and critical stages
Visibility into owners, status and next steps
More predictability for leadership, finance and operations

solutions.title: GECOM engagement models
solutions.subtitle: The engagement model is calibrated to the stage, volume and complexity of your operation.
solutions.investmentNote: The investment is calibrated to the volume and complexity of your operation, which is why we start with a free diagnostic.
